g.text: Solver Residual Diagnostics: Nonlinear and Linear Convergence
Nonlinear stop: at least 2 iterations and global OR step-relative ratio ≤ 10⁻¹⁰. Linear stop: relative 10⁻¹⁰ OR absolute 10⁻²⁴.
